integrity: The Fourier positivity argument is analytic. The bound for the first spherical-Bessel zero and the parameter comparison use an included exact-rational standalone script. These scientific assessments are not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Proves a uniform, sufficient zero-free transverse cylinder and a particular integer-coordinate six-vertex witness; does not determine exact nearest-zero radius, sharp cylinder width, or optimal stretching. Unindexed historical priority is possible. No independent audit.
title: A six-vertex octahedral counterexample for the Fourier-zero isoperimetric problem
